question: What happens to the items in a stack when you push and then pop?

beats.speaker: interviewer
beats.line: What happens to the items in a stack when you push and then pop?

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: Pushing places a new item on top of the items already there.
beats.source_quote: Pushing places a new item on top of the items already there

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: Popping takes the top item away and leaves the rest untouched.
beats.source_quote: popping takes the top item away and leaves the rest untouched

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: So pushing A then B then C leaves C on top, and the next pop returns C.
beats.source_quote: Pushing A then B then C leaves C on top, so the next pop returns C and leaves B reachable underneath.
